# Token Exposure Risk

The reliance on environment variables for sensitive tokens introduces a risk of accidental exposure if these variables are not managed securely. This risk is especially pertinent if the environment is shared or lacks proper configuration.

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.__init__`
